text: EasyJet disclosed it is evaluating a £5.7 billion acquisition proposal from Apollo Global Management while an existing proposal from Castlelake remains active through its offer period. The board stated it is no longer minded to recommend the Castlelake proposal. Multiple acquisition proposals simultaneously remain under consideration.

meta.note: Competing acquisition proposals coexist; no definitive ownership outcome has been established.

text: The International Energy Agency forecast global oil demand to decline by 1 million barrels per day year over year in 2026. The forecast assumes gradual recovery of tanker flows through the Strait of Hormuz while identifying continued uncertainty around that condition. Oil demand projections and expected market balance remain conditional within the published outlook.

meta.note: This entry logs the published forecast as an institutional state rather than observed physical demand.
